leadIn.title: Lead-In & Context: There was/were & There will be
leadIn.content: Existence in past and future: Yesterday there was a party in the street. Tomorrow there will be a concert in the park.

meaningCheck.question: Function check: What is the primary purpose of using There was/were & There will be?
options: To express clear, level-appropriate meaning in structured context
To translate sentences word-for-word from another language
It is an obsolete form never used by native speakers
meaningCheck.explanation: Correct · This structure provides explicit grammatical function and clarity.

meaningCheck.question: Form check: Does correct usage of There was/were & There will be require matching subject, verb, and modifier agreements?
options: No, agreement rules are optional in English
Yes, matching grammatical forms ensures natural, accurate communication
Agreement only matters in formal academic writing
meaningCheck.explanation: Correct · Accurate form and agreement choices prevent misunderstandings.

form.title: Form & Structure: There was/were & There will be
form.content: Past: There was (singular) / There were (plural). Future: There will be + noun (singular & plural).

pronunciation.title: Pronunciation Notes: There was/were & There will be

controlledPractice.question: 'There ___ many people at the party.'
controlledPractice.explanation: Many people is plural → there were.

controlledPractice.question: Fix: 'There will a test tomorrow.'
options: There will be a test tomorrow.
There will is a test tomorrow.
There be will a test tomorrow.
controlledPractice.explanation: The future form needs 'be': there will be.

controlledPractice.question: Which talks about something that no longer exists?
controlledPractice.explanation: 'There was' places the existence in the past.
